'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russian occupation of the Luhansk Oblast]]
****Luhansk Governor [[Serhiy Haidai]] says that Russian forces captured the towns of Pidlisne and [[Myrna Dolyna]], south of [[Lysychansk]], and also confirms reports that separatist forces captured [[Toshkivka]] yesterday. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-forces-capture-several-more-settlements-ukraines-luhansk-region-2022-06-21/ (Reuters)]
**The [[Governor of Kharkiv Oblast]], [[Oleh Synyehubov]], reports that Russian shelling killed 15 civilians in and near [[Kharkiv]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/least-15-civilians-killed-kharkiv-region-by-russian-shelling-governor-2022-06-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] man is stabbed and killed by an [[Israel]]i [[settler]] in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-settler-stabs-palestinian-death-palestinians-say-2022-06-21/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**[[2022 United Kingdom national rail strike]]
***[[Rail transport|Railway transport]] workers go on a nationwide [[general strike]] in the [[United Kingdom]] after talks on a 7% pay increase for workers collapses. The [[National Union of Rail, Maritime and Transport Workers|RMT]] says that industry executives have only offered a 2% increase in pay, which is well below rising [[inflation]] levels. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-61861040 (BBC News)]
*[[Economic impact of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russia]] becomes [[China]]'s biggest supplier of [[oil]], surpassing [[Saudi Arabia]] and making up over half of China's oil imports. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2022/6/20/china-oil-imports-from-sanctioned-russia-skyrocket-surpass-saudi (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Wildfires in 2022]]
**[[2022 California wildfires]]
***The Edgewood Fire breaks out near [[San Mateo County, California|San Mateo County]], [[California]], prompting evacuations and power outages. A firefighter is injured while fighting the fires. [https://www.cbsnews.com/sanfrancisco/video/raw-chopper-5-video-of-the-edgewood-fire-burning-in-san-mateo-county/ (CBS News)] [https://www.nbcbayarea.com/news/local/peninsula/crews-respond-to-fire-in-emerald-hills-area-in-san-mateo-county/2925224/?amp (KNTV)] [https://abc7news.com/amp/redwood-city-fire-edgewood-park-san-mateo-county-emerald-hills/11985220/ (KGO-TV)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Macau]]
***Authorities in [[Macau]] place a casino and hotel with more than 700 people inside under lockdown due to an outbreak of [[COVID-19]] in the territory. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/macau-hotel-locked-down-after-covid-19-case-700-people-to-be-quarantined-media (''Straits Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Lithuania–Russia relations]]
***[[Security Council of Russia|Russian Security Council]] Secretary [[Nikolai Patrushev]] warns [[Lithuania]] that its citizens will "feel pain" over the ban on the transit of Russian goods to [[Kaliningrad Oblast|Kaliningrad]] through Lithuania, saying that Russia's response in the near future could have "a serious negative impact on the population of Lithuania". [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/amid-row-with-west-putin-ally-arrives-russias-kaliningrad-ria-2022-06-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Estonia–Russia relations]]
**[[Estonia]] reports that a [[Border Service of the Federal Security Service of the Russian Federation|Russian Border Service]] [[Mil Mi-8|Mi-8]] helicopter violated its airspace over the weekend. The [[List of ambassadors of Russia to Estonia|Russian ambassador to Estonia]] was summoned in response to the incident. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2022/06/21/Russian-border-guard-helicopter-violates-Estonia-s-airspace (Al Arabiya)] 
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on international relations]]
**The [[United Nations]] announces that [[2022 Kunming Biodiversity Conference|the conference]] of the parties to the [[Convention on Biological Diversity]] initially scheduled to take place in [[Kunming]], [[China]], later this year will be moved to [[Montreal]], [[Canada]], due to logistical complications caused by [[Chinese government response to COVID-19#Zero-COVID policy|China's Zero-COVID policy]]. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/chinas-covid-19-controls-force-u-n-biodiversity-conference-to-move-to-canada-11655810917 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
*[[2021–2022 global energy crisis]]
**[[Lebanon]], [[Egypt]] and [[Syria]] sign an agreement to supply Egyptian gas to a power plant in northern Lebanon through Syria. However, the [[World Bank]], which is financing the deal, must validate the agreement before it can take effect. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/lebanon-ap-syria-egypt-world-bank-b2105896.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Cross-Strait relations]]
**Twenty-nine [[China|Chinese]] [[military aircraft]] enter the [[Taiwan]]ese [[air defence zone]], prompting the Taiwanese [[Republic of China Air Force|Air Force]] to send their own aircraft in response. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taiwan-scrambles-29-jets-warn-away-chinese-planes-its-air-defence-zone-2022-06-21/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Two people are injured, including one in critical condition, after a [[stabbing attack]] in [[Västerås]], [[Sweden]]. [https://apnews.com/article/stockholm-sweden-cb189498630d06ffd7ce9f6ae4f08265 (AP)]
*[[Riot]]ers attack an [[International Day of Yoga]] celebration in [[Malé]], [[the Maldives]], proclaiming that yoga is against the tenets of [[Islam]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/protesters-attack-yoga-day-event-maldives-2022-06-21/ (Reuters)]
*The [[South Dakota Senate]], in the [[United States]], votes to convict [[Attorney General of South Dakota|Attorney General]] [[Jason Ravnsborg]] over his role in a 2020 car accident in which his car struck 55-year old Joseph Boever, removing him from office immediately. [https://apnews.com/article/jason-ravnsborg-south-dakota-impeachments-e5d62c76eedecf4c9290fecd821496aa (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 food crises]]
**[[Egypt]] rejects two [[World Trade Organization]] (WTO) agreements which would have forced it to export domestically needed food to alleviate the global food crisis, citing proposals that it considers harmful to developing countries and also noting that 30 other WTO member states restrict food exports. [https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2022/06/egypt-rejects-world-trade-organization-agreements-global-food-crisis (Al Monitor)]
*The [[Armed Forces of Ecuador|armed forces]] of [[Ecuador]] say that they will "not allow ongoing protests" to "damage the country's democracy", as road blockades and demonstrations against the economic policies of president [[Guillermo Lasso]] continue. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/ecuadors-military-vows-stop-protests-damaging-democracy-2022-06-21/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Internet censorship in Russia]]
**Russia blocks access to ''[[The Daily Telegraph]]'s'' website on the orders of the [[Prosecutor-General of Russia|Prosecutor-General]], after accusing the newspaper of "disseminating false information" about the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|Russian war in Ukraine]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-gb/news/world/russia-blocks-the-telegraph-s-website-for-war-coverage/ar-AAYH13f?ocid=msedgdhp&pc=U531&cvid=cf6fbd4012d84bac8414a0d91d31ab6c (MSN)]
*[[Nuri (rocket)|Nuri]], South Korea's first locally-developed [[Orbital spaceflight|orbital]] [[launch vehicle]], launches for a second time from the [[Naro Space Center]] in [[Goheung County]], [[South Jeolla Province|South Jeolla]], with a satellite payload of {{cvt|1500|kg}}. The launch was successful, with all of the satellites being put onto the {{cvt|700|km}} [[Sun-synchronous orbit]]. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1614085/south-korea-launches-domestically-developed-space-rocket (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]
